limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost guard evaluation during limit order matching

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (bitwise AND of the two amounts is zero)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost guard evaluation during limit order matching

zero_cost_guard_triggered.meaning: the zero-cost trade guard fires (treats the trade as zero-cost)
zero_cost_guard_triggered.checkpoint: at zero-cost guard evaluation during limit order matching

one_side_receives_without_sending.meaning: one side receives tokens without sending any (the genuine zero-cost trade condition the guard is meant to detect)
one_side_receives_without_sending.checkpoint: at zero-cost guard evaluation during limit order matching

traders_encounter_unexplained_failures.meaning: traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, encounter unexplained failures

assumptions: The zero-cost guard's trigger state and the genuine zero-cost condition are each observable at the guard evaluation checkpoint.

unresolved.description: The exact zero-cost check expression and its operands are not fully quoted in prose; the guard-triggered and one-side-receives-without-sending observables are represented as grounded Booleans pending code binding.

limitations: The correspondence pattern encodes that the guard triggers exactly when one side receives without sending; the report's mechanism (bitwise AND instead of logical OR) is context, not part of I.
Impact is potential; the impact_outcome Boolean records the reported potential outcome without asserting inevitability.
